limitations: Complete115237character44-page institutional revision read. All30patient Table1 columns and all22variant Table2 rows inspected text/pixels. Main figure1–4 artwork absent, captions read only. Supplementary Figures1–9,Tables1–3,SupplementalData not held/read. No controlled-access sequencing data opened.

Identity exact title/lead authors and UCL repository provenance match PMID39306721/DOI10.1016/j.gim.2024.101273; PDF itself has neither DOI nor PMID and is R1June20,2024. Canonical author list contains additions relative to revision. Do not call this final publication read.

Mapped contradictions/version issues: Individual22 packetMALE versus Table1FEMALE. Individual2 packetc1328T>G/pL443R versus manuscriptc1328T>G/pL443P; nucleotide change supports Arg, so qualify likely source annotation error. Individual22c1_18del has pM1_D6delTable1/p?Table2/packetMet1?; no reinitiation assay.

Strong source inconsistencies: abstract30patients23families versus clinical paragraph27; severe1–17 versus Table1severe1–19. Death14/19narrative versus13/19summary; individual row death counts must not inherit either unchecked. Narrative stillbornFamily8I9–11 conflicts Table1/figure livinginfants; Table1 assigns stillbirth toFamily9I12–14. Individual2death10m versus Figure2MRI3.5y. Family20 refers Individual25 versus Table1Individual27. Table2F12I7 should cross-reference I17; no automatic repair of source.

Allele typos: main c1235G>A calledG412A but Table2c1235G>C; Table2S409Pc1225C>T versus genomicT>C and Table1c1225T>C; c502C>G versus narrativec504C>G. Intro20variants18new versus Results22. Figure3gnomADv3.1.2/76156 versus textv2.1.1/141456; prediction-comparison dataset must not be claimed exact reproduced.

FLVCR1 missense transport assays coexpress CHKA/ETNK1 and measure radiolabel accumulation, not endogenous neuron rescue. Most mutants reduced transport, but residual choline transport mild34.3±21.9 versus severe35.5±21.9,p.9222: no demonstrated severity discrimination. D421Ntransport normal yet minigene exon skipping; cDNA assay misses splicing. M151Vnormal plus AP4B1/AMPD2/NOTCH2blended phenotype supports benign alternative rather than sweeping all FLVCR1variants causal.

Proposed dosage model biologically plausible, not quantitatively established; first-exon truncations may escapeNMD/allowreinitiation, contradict simple guaranteed-null reading. Mitochondrial versus plasma isoform effects and nutrition proposed modifiers, unmeasured. No human choline/ethanolamine levels or supplementation trial here.

Individual7RCOR3P528L remains candidate/multilocus alternative. Untested affected relativesI6/I12/I14explicitly marked inferred, not proven genotypes. Asymptomatic homozygous26yearoldsister ofFamily20 could reflect age-dependent penetrance but does not prove it. FounderG464S Family1/7 not two fully independent alleles.

Mapped mildFamily16–18cases use packet severeNDD OMIMlabel despite source mild spectrum/no ID23/24. Gene/allele match is not exact disease-category validation. No clinical therapeutic superiority or drug rescue established.
All inherited outcome exposure aggregate only; no per-case ranking/result files read, cases/results unchanged.
